messages:
anya (People Ops): Heads-up: rolling out a short "Privacy & Acceptable Data Use" micro-training for all staff, contractors, and temps. Estimated time: ~12 mins + 3 quick quiz Qs. Completion required by Mon Apr 20. :hourglass:

saira (HRBP): Link to course + tracker: https://tiny.redwood/priv-refresher. Managers: please add a row per direct report on the tracker and mark contractors.

marco (Eng Manager): Are vendor-managed consultants included? We have a consultant on a vendor contract.

anya (People Ops): Include any headcount that accesses internal data. For vendor-managed folks, if the vendor retains control of access, send me the contract ID and I'll confirm exceptions.

leo (Eng): FYI — completion will gate performance calibration eligibility for ICs this cycle. Flagging so managers can prioritize.

marco (Eng Manager): Got it. I'll add a blocker note to next week's 1:1s.

nisha (HRIS): Can we automate ingestion of completions into HRIS? If ops-bot can drop a nightly CSV I can reconcile.

ops-bot: @nisha export scheduled: /internal/hr/exports/privacy_refresher_2026-04-18.csv next run 2026-04-18T02:00Z :robot_face:

anya (People Ops): Also: handbook update coming for "Data Handling". Small PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/455. Key changes: clearer S3 access rules, KMS key ownership, and a slimmer exception approval flow.

marco (Eng Manager): Question: who is the approver for exceptions now — security or legal?

saira (HRBP): Short answer: it depends. Infra-level infra access exceptions = security + legal sign-off. Product/data collection exceptions = PM + legal. I'll add a decision tree to the PR to make triage faster.

leo (Eng): Would be great to have a manager reminder one week before deadline in the team channel.

anya (People Ops): Scheduled manager nudges for 2026-04-13. Template below — feel free to edit:
"Hi <manager>, reminder: your team needs to complete the Privacy Refresher by Apr 20. Update the completion tracker (link above). For exceptions or vendor queries, ping @anya. Thanks!"

marco (Eng Manager): Template looks good, thanks.

nisha (HRIS): I'll ingest the CSV after the 4/18 run and run a reconciliation job. I'll open a short report on 4/19 showing missing completions and CC managers.

ops-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by ops-bot

anya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll post a brief status update on 4/15 and follow up on any edge cases. If anyone has folks on odd-time zones, DM me and we'll extend windows where needed.
